question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 50,000 for one year at 8% per annum when compounded half yearly.
solution:
**Given:**

The principal = Rs. 50,000 , Rate of interest = 8 % 

**Formula used:**

For compound interest, Amount = P (1 + R/100)n [ P = principal, R = rate of interest and n = number of years}

**Concept used:**

Interest is half yearly, so rate of interest will be 8/2 = 4% , interest received 2 times in 1 year

**Calculation:**

Amount = P (1 + R/100)n [

⇒ P (1 + R/100)n 

⇒ 50000 ×(1 + 4/100)² 

⇒ 50000 × (1 + 1/25)²

⇒ 50000 × 26/25× 26/25

⇒ Rs 54080

The interest will be 54080 - 50000 = Rs. 4,080

**∴ The correct option is 3**
